quests.LogDescription: 'Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.'
quests.QuestDescription: 'There, it looks like there\'s a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.\n\nAccording to my  intel, your dragons should be up there. Let\'s just hope that they\'re still in a state to help you.'

quests.LogDescription: 'Find and rescue the mother of the Thorignir brood.'
quests.QuestDescription:
'Through brute force and corruption, the God-King has taken the power you seek, but there may be hope for you and the Thorignir, $C.

With the aid of fel powers such as I've never seen, the Felskorn are corrupting our young and seeking to enslave the Thorignir. Their leader, a demon of great power, has captured our mother and seeks to bend her to the God-King's will.

Find her and free her from the demon's grasp - only then might the Thorignir regain our power and grant you aid.'

quests.LogDescription: 'Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.'
quests.QuestDescription: 'You should have a good vantage from this tower to grapple over to the mountain path. I can\'t help you once you\'re across, but you should be able to take it all the way up to the top. \n\nI hope you\'re able to find what you need from the dragons up there. Who knows what the God-King has done to them.'
